capabilities: Render Markdown headings and lists as a left-to-right mind map
Edit, reorder and re-parent nodes with keyboard and drag-and-drop
Fold branches and show a set number of levels per note
Export maps as PNG, SVG or OPML
Search node text and notes and browse a heading table of contents
extras: The manifest warns the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; a Chinese-language interface and README are also available.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view and edit a note's outline as a mind map, forcing users to choose between the text file and an external mapping tool.

relations.evidence: Turn Markdown outlines into an XMind-style mind map in Obsidian.

summary: Mind-map editor that renders Markdown headings and list items as an XMind-style tree and writes every edit back to the note file.
